test_chat_panel_closes_on_second_click.title: Verify the chat panel closes when the chat icon is clicked again.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Search > More Filters
steps.expected: More Filters page loads without errors

steps.action: Verify the initial unfiltered list or data set is displayed
steps.expected: All items are shown before applying any search or filter

steps.action: Note the total count of items before filtering
steps.expected: Initial item count is recorded

steps.action: Locate the search input field or filter controls
steps.expected: Search/filter UI is visible and accessible

steps.action: Enter the search criteria or select the filter option for More Filters panel closes
steps.expected: Search/filter input accepts the value

steps.action: Trigger the search or apply the filter (press Enter or click Apply)
steps.expected: The list updates to show filtered results

steps.action: Verify the results match the search/filter criteria
steps.expected: All displayed items match the applied criteria

steps.action: Verify the result count updated to reflect the filtered set
steps.expected: Item count is less than or equal to the original count

steps.action: Set up precondition: when clicking outside
steps.expected: Precondition is met (when clicking outside)

steps.action: Clear the search/filter and verify all items return
steps.expected: Clearing the filter restores the full unfiltered list

test_chat_panel_has_content.title: An open panel shows the search input plus either the

steps.action: Click the chat icon in the header.
steps.expected: The panel opens with its search field and shows either the 'use the search bar' instruction or the recent conversations list, each row naming a conversation.

test_click_search_result_opens_chat.title: Clicking a search result reaches the conversation: a

steps.action: Open the chat panel, search the configured user and click the result.
steps.expected: The conversation opens with its message field (placeholder Enter Message Here).

steps.action: Click back.
steps.expected: The recent conversations list holds a row with the user's name.

test_chat_icon_visible_on_events_page.title: The chat panel opens from the Events page too

steps.action: Open Events, then click the chat icon in the header.
steps.expected: The address ends in /events and the panel opens with its empty Search field.

test_chat_panel_survives_page_refresh.title: The panel opens after a page refresh

steps.action: Refresh the browser, then click the chat icon in the header.
steps.expected: The address is unchanged by the refresh and the panel opens with its empty Search field.
